# Sploot Vets

> > Sploot Vets delivers comprehensive veterinary care including emergency, urgent, and preventive services across Chicago, Denver, Colorado Springs, and Salt Lake City with same-day appointments and Fear Free certified practices.

Sploot Vets is a multi-location veterinary care network offering primary care, emergency services, surgical procedures, and specialized treatments. The practice emphasizes preventive care, pet wellness, and convenient access through their SplootPack membership program and Sploot Vets app.

## Key Topics

- Emergency veterinary care
- Urgent care services
- Preventive care & wellness exams
- Vaccinations & immunizations
- Surgical services (spay/neuter)
- Dental care
- Same-day appointments
- SplootPack membership
- Fear Free certification
- Puppy & kitten wellness plans
- Parasite prevention
- Behavioral health
- Pet Parent Concierge
- Multi-location network
- SplootRx pharmacy

## Core Veterinary Services

- [Top-notch Veterinary Services in Denver, CO and Chicago, IL](https://www.splootvets.com/our-services): Overview of Sploot's veterinary services including wellness, urgent, and emergency care
- [Emergency Vet | Sploot Veterinary Care](https://www.splootvets.com/our-services/emergency-care): Emergency veterinary hospital services in Denver, Chicago, and Colorado Springs
- [Urgent Care & Sick Visits - Sploot Vets](https://www.splootvets.com/our-services/urgent-care-vet): Urgent care and sick visit services available 365 days with same-day appointments
- [Pet Wellness Exams & Preventive Vet Care Services](https://www.splootvets.com/our-services/wellness-preventive-care): Preventive care and wellness exams for pets across Sploot locations
- [Dog Vaccines & Cat Vaccines - Protect Your Pet - Sploot Vets](https://www.splootvets.com/our-services/vaccinations-for-cats-and-dogs): Dog and cat vaccination services with puppy and kitten shot schedules
- [Dental Care for Pets in Denver, CO and Chicago, IL](https://www.splootvets.com/our-services/dental-care-at-sploot): Pet dental care including cleanings, X-rays, and oral surgeries in Denver and Chicago

## Surgical Services & Specialized Care

- [Veterinary Surgery for Dogs & Cats - Sploot Veterinary Care](https://www.splootvets.com/our-services/veterinary-surgery): Comprehensive surgical services including spay/neuter, mass removal, and dental surgery
- [Spay and Neuter Clinic for Dogs & Cats - Sploot Vets](https://www.splootvets.com/our-services/veterinary-surgery/spaying-neutering): Spay and neuter surgical services for dogs and cats in Denver and Chicago
- [Additional Services - Sploot Veterinary Care](https://www.splootvets.com/our-services/additional-services): Specialized services including behavioral health, dermatology, and end-of-life care

## Life Stage Care Programs

- [Kitten Wellness Plans and Vaccine Schedule - Sploot Vets](https://www.splootvets.com/our-services/kittens): Kitten wellness plans, vaccine schedules, and care guidance for new pet parents
